releases.title: Listen to your news

highlights.title: Read aloud
highlights.text: Listen to a day's posts, the Story, a TL;DR or a full article.

highlights.title: Your choice of voice
highlights.text: Pick a female or male voice, its speed and pitch, in Settings › Listening.

highlights.title: Player controls
highlights.text: Pause, skip to the next post or stop from the bar at the bottom.

changes: Listen buttons next to each day or week, on the Story, in inline TL;DRs and in the TL;DR panel
Listen to the full article: BlogPulse reads the article page, or the feed excerpt when the page can't be read
Player bar with pause, next and stop; the post being read is highlighted
Settings › Listening: voice menu grouped by language with Female and Male filters, speed, pitch and a voice test
Uses the iPhone's own voices (free, offline); falls back to the system voice when speech isn't available
fixes: The TL;DR hint now points to Settings › AI settings

releases.title: Built with

highlights.title: Built with
highlights.text: A new last section in Settings shows the shared blueprints BlogPulse is built from.

highlights.title: Read how it works
highlights.text: Each blueprint opens at the exact version this release follows.

highlights.title: Same as the other apps
highlights.text: Strava Daily Digest, Dienynas+ and Go2FGym show the same section.

changes: Settings › Built with: In-app updates, Settings and AI configuration, each with its version and the BlogPulse version that brought it in, plus a link to all blueprints
BLUEPRINTS block in the script, so the blueprints inventory can read what BlogPulse follows
docs/BLUEPRINTS.md lists the same blueprints with links and deviations
fixes: Links from Built with open only pages in the blueprints repository

releases.title: Pull down to refresh

highlights.title: Pull to refresh
highlights.text: Pull the list down and hold until the ring fills to check every blog again.

highlights.title: Your hold time
highlights.text: Choose how long to hold, from instant to 5 seconds, in Settings.

highlights.title: No accidental checks
highlights.text: Let go early and nothing happens, so a casual drag never refreshes.

changes: Pull-to-refresh on the post list with a hold ring and status text
New setting: Settings › Checking blogs › Pull-to-refresh hold (0 to 5 seconds, default 1.5)
Pulling is ignored while a sheet is open, during a running check, and for sideways swipes
The refresh button in the header stays as before

releases.title: Your tech blogs, sorted and summarised

highlights.title: Story of your blogs
highlights.text: The latest posts blended into one short, cited read, per topic.

highlights.title: TL;DR in place
highlights.text: Tap TL;DR on any post to read its summary right in the list.

highlights.title: Topic pages
highlights.text: Posts sorted into Tech, AI, Finance and more. Swipe between pages.

changes: Checks every followed blog each time the app opens and marks what's new
Follow blogs by searching or by pasting any address; the RSS or Atom feed is found automatically
Mark read or unread, rate posts 1 to 3 stars, group by day or by week
Picks: unread posts similar to the ones you rate highest
Topic pages sorted by AI or by keywords, with a per-blog override
Story: an AI-written briefing of the latest posts with citations and a TL;DR box
TL;DR on any post, inline; extracted from the article when no AI key is set
Invite to read: an AI-written message in your own words, shared with one tap
Home-screen widget with a short summary and the top pick
Seven colour themes, three layouts, four text sizes, sans or serif headlines
AI settings: Claude or OpenAI key, model picker loaded from your account, token usage per provider, model and feature
Settings screen for every limit and timing, with reset to defaults
In-app updates from GitHub with a two-day Later
